45.DSCR:
An organization to which boys and girls with $$トップレス$$ ability belong.
Alongside protecting the human rights of the $$トップレス$$, it holds a powerful voice and budget by virtue of monopolizing the $$バスターマシン$$, the trump card against $$宇宙怪獣$$, and possesses combat strength on par with the $$宇宙軍$$.
Garrison bases exist throughout the Solar System, beginning with the '$$メガネビュラ$$' base on Mars.
In order to prevent the $$トップレス$$, who are children, from being exploited by adults, it maintains a system in which adult intervention is excluded.

46.DSCR:
Users of psychic powers that manifest mainly in children.
The ability itself manifests in any child, but its magnitude and orientation vary from individual to individual, and among them, children with especially great ability are scouted by the $$フラタニティ$$ and become pilots of the $$バスターマシン$$.
When they activate their ability, a phenomenon occurs in which the head shines brilliantly, and the intensity of that light is proportional to the magnitude of the ability.
As they approach adulthood, the ability declines, and eventually there comes a time called '$$あがり$$', when it is lost entirely (100%).

47.DSCR:
The ability of the $$トップレス$$ to transcend the laws of physics and rewrite motion performance, information, and space.
It is also used for the power and attacks of the $$バスターマシン$$, and causes various phenomena depending on the characteristics of the machine and the aptitude of the $$トップレス$$.

48.DSCR:
The military forces held by the $$イングレッサ$$ territory and the $$ボルジャーノ$$ territory.
They are referred to with the territory they belong to placed at the front, as in the '$$イングレッサ$$ $$ミリシャ$$'.
Until they began direct negotiations with the $$ムーンレィス$$, they possessed only weapons reminiscent of the Industrial Revolution era, such as biplanes and cannons. But ever since the $$∀ガンダム#robot$$ emerged from the $$ホワイトドール$$, they unearthed mobile suits one after another from the $$マウンテンサイクル$$ and strengthened their armament.

49.DSCR:
A phenomenon seen in $$メール・ビーター$$ during the $$多元戦争$$.
Her biological time is stopped, and neither growth nor aging can be seen.
It was surmised that the $$時の牢獄$$ created by the $$新世時空震動$$ would rewrite not a single life but the laws of the entire world into this.
49.DSC2:
A phenomenon seen in $$メール・ビーター$$ during the $$多元戦争$$.
Her biological time is stopped, and neither growth nor aging can be seen.
This was a measure taken by the $$スフィア$$ of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$ to hold fast the soul of $$メール$$, who had once lost her life, but as a result the $$スフィア$$ had come to exist split between the $$ガンレオン$$ and $$メール$$. However, when $$ランド$$ awakened as a Reactor, the $$スフィア$$ within $$メール$$ was torn away and integrated within the $$ガンレオン$$, and $$メール$$'s time began to move.
It was surmised that the $$時の牢獄$$ created by the $$新世時空震動$$ would rewrite not a single life but the laws of the entire world into this.

50.DSCR:
A system that scatters countless nanomachines, riding on an I-Field, that have the function of breaking artificial materials down into sand.
Mounted on the $$∀ガンダム#robot$$ and the $$ターンＸ$$, it is recorded in the $$黒歴史$$ as having destroyed the scientific civilization of the former century.
The ejected nanomachines reflect light and shine in rainbow colors, looking like the wings of a butterfly.

51.DSCR:
Something that various forces, including the $$ビスト財団$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$, are searching for.
It is said that 'when the box is opened, the $$連邦政府$$ will perish', and because the coordinates of its location are revealed by the '$$Ｌａ＋（ラプラス）システム$$' mounted on the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ is called the 'key' that opens the box.
51.DSC2:
Something that various forces, including the $$ビスト財団$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$, are searching for.
It is said that 'when the box is opened, the $$連邦政府$$ will perish', and because the coordinates of its location are revealed by the '$$Ｌａ＋（ラプラス）システム$$' mounted on the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ is called the 'key' that opens the box.
Its true nature is the stone monument of the true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter that $$サイアム・ビスト$$, the founder of the $$ビスト財団$$, had kept hidden. Its final article, 'If, in the future, the emergence of a new humanity adapted to space is recognized, those persons shall be given priority in taking part in the administration of the government', has been deleted from the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter that is currently made public.

54.DSCR:
Founder of the private armed organization $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.
According to the records, a figure of the past who actually lived more than 200 years ago.
He was a genius scientist who, 200 years earlier, had completed technologies such as the $$ＧＮドライヴ$$ and $$ヴェーダ$$, which were said to be decades ahead of their time even as of 2307.
In a message video sent to the media of the entire world after $$刹那$$ and the others carried out their first armed intervention, he declared that armed intervention would be carried out in order to eradicate war.
He had been in cold sleep on the far side of the Moon together with the main body of $$ヴェーダ$$, but was discovered by the ambitious $$アレハンドロ$$ and shot dead.
His true purpose lay in 'unifying the will of humanity toward expansion into space and transforming humanity in preparation for the "$$来たるべき対話$$"', and to that end in guiding the appearance of $$イノベイター$$s.

55.DSCR:
In the $$ＡＤＷ$$, a representative of the Peacekeeping Council of the former $$国連$$, and currently Supreme Commander of the Earth Federation Forces.
When he was representative of the Peacekeeping Council, he formed a special international rescue team that acted beyond the bounds of organization and position for the peace and happiness of all humanity.
He possesses a strong will that does not hesitate at immediate sacrifice, but voices of suspicion are also being raised over his forceful methods and his unreadable true intentions.
Also, though its truth is unconfirmed, records remain suggesting he has lived for over 200 years, and there are many mysteries surrounding him.
His true identity was one of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, those who touched $$クロノエイチ$$.
In order to entrust humanity's future to those who would follow, he gave up his life in the closing stages of the $$再世戦争$$.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese is ＡＤＷの元国連の平和維持理事会の代表; 元 modifies 国連 (the former UN), not the representative, and ＡＤＷ is the era, not an authority he served 'under'

58.DSCR:
A special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.
The captain is $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ and the vice-captain is $$サルディアス・アクス$$.
Its main forces are the $$アンゲロイＡＮＴ$$ and the $$シャウラス$$.
Its members wear pilot suits like restraints, and on the battlefield they attack enemies with their hatred laid bare.
They are not people of any particular star or of a single race; $$バルビエル$$ personally finds those who harbor hatred, breaks down their reason, and uses them as soldiers.
58.DSC2:
A special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.
The captain is $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ and the vice-captain is $$サルディアス・アクス$$.
Its main forces are the $$アンゲロイＡＮＴ$$ and the $$シャウラス$$.
Its members wear pilot suits like restraints, and on the battlefield they attack enemies with their hatred laid bare.
They are not people of any particular star or of a single race; $$バルビエル$$ personally finds those who harbor hatred, breaks down their reason, and uses them as soldiers.
After the death of $$バルビエル$$, the unit was disbanded and its members scattered.

59.DSCR:
A plan that $$ルルーシュ$$ secretly carried through to completion together with $$スザク$$ and an extremely small number of collaborators.
Its content was this: $$ルルーシュ$$, having ascended to the throne as Emperor of the $$神聖ブリタニア帝国$$, would use that position and military power to rule as a dictator, gathering the anger and hatred of the people onto $$ルルーシュ$$; then, by having $$ルルーシュ$$ struck down by '$$ゼロ$$', played by $$スザク$$, create the fact of '$$ゼロ$$, the hero who defeated the Demon King $$ルルーシュ$$', and so wipe hatred from the world.
Its purpose was for $$ルルーシュ$$ to atone for his own sins with his own life.

61.DSCR:
A weapon of mass destruction that $$ニーナ$$ developed together with $$インヴォーグ$$, a research team under $$シュナイゼル$$.
The name is short for 'Field Limitary Effective Implosion Armament'.
It makes a certain range of space vanish completely, air included, but produces no secondary effects such as radiation.
Also, an anti-$$フレイヤ$$ weapon, the '$$フレイヤ・エリミネーター$$', was developed by $$ニーナ$$ herself, the developer.

62.DSCR:
The war between the $$ジオン公国$$, which declared independence, and the Earth Federation.
It is called by this name because roughly a year passed between the opening of hostilities and the end of the war.
The $$一年戦争$$ was the first in history to field mobile suits, and it overturned every strategy and tactic that came before.
Though the $$ジオン公国$$ was defeated, thanks to the exploits of the $$ガンダム$$ and of the $$ホワイトベース$$ team to which its pilot $$アムロ$$ belonged, and the covert maneuvers of $$シャア$$, who burned with a desire for revenge against the $$ザビ家$$ that dominated the $$ジオン公国$$, the name of $$ジオン$$ lived on in many changed forms and still carries great weight in the friction between the Spacenoids who live in space and the Earthnoids who live on Earth.

63.DSCR:
Chairman of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council.
Unlike his predecessor $$パトリック・ザラ$$, he is a moderate who sought a road to coexistence and peace with $$ナチュラル$$s. During the $$ユニウスセブン$$ drop and the fighting with the $$地球連合$$ that followed, he consistently made calm, accurate judgments and showed excellent leadership.
He is also an authority on genetic research, and it is thought that it was through that work that he came to know $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$ and $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$. There are also signs that he had anticipated from the start that $$シン$$ would manifest the SEED.
He set up $$ミーア・キャンベル$$ as a stand-in for $$ラクス・クライン$$ in an attempt to raise the fighting spirit of all of the $$プラント$$. But it came to light that behind the scenes he had plotted the assassination of $$ラクス$$ herself, and this earned him the distrust of $$キラ$$ and the others.
His ultimate aim was to build a managed society controlling humanity at the genetic level, which he called the '$$デスティニープラン$$'. After annihilating $$ロゴス$$, he declared the introduction and implementation of the plan to the world, only to be stopped by $$キラ$$ and the others, who refused a world where evolution would halt.
At the last he was shot by $$レイ#pt136$$, whom he had trusted like a son. He closed his life in the arms of $$タリア$$, who had once been his lover and toward whom he had continued to hold feelings even after they parted.

proofread.reason: omitted subject: 別れてもなお想いを寄せ続けていた is Durandal's feelings for Talia; 'for whom feelings had never faded' left the holder of the feelings unstated

64.DSCR:
A general term for humans born from embryos whose genes were adjusted at the fertilized egg stage so that they would have advanced intelligence and robust bodies. Their existence came to light through the confession of $$ジョージ・グレン$$, the $$ファーストコーディネイター$$, which was broadcast to the entire world in C.E. 15.
They acquire many excellent qualities, both physical and mental, from birth. However, whether those abilities blossom depends on the environment in which they grow up.
Most $$コーディネイター$$s live in the $$プラント$$, but there are exceptional places where they coexist with $$ナチュラル$$s (ordinary humans who have not undergone genetic adjustment), such as neutral nations like $$オーブ$$ and lunar cities.
Those born to $$ナチュラル$$ parents through genetic adjustment are called 'First-Generation $$コーディネイター$$s', and children born between $$コーディネイター$$s are called 'Second-Generation $$コーディネイター$$s'.
However, the birth rate is declining year by year, and this has become a major problem in $$コーディネイター$$ society.

65.DSCR:
A man, the first $$コーディネイター$$ in history. For that reason he is called the '$$ファーストコーディネイター$$'.
While still young, he achieved great accomplishments in a variety of fields, such as scholarship, sports, and the military, and showed people the possibilities of humans through genetic manipulation.
The word '$$コーディネイター$$' that he proposed carries the meaning 'an adjuster who will be a bridge between the new humanity and humanity', but its true meaning was not understood, and as a result $$ナチュラル$$s and $$コーディネイター$$s came to carry on a long-running feud and conflict.

66.DSCR:
A military-industrial complex said to have existed since the dawn of recorded history, wielding powerful influence over politics. It is made up of merchants of death who have secretly manipulated wars and reconstructions to reap enormous profits.
It served as the backing organization for $$ブルーコスモス$$, guiding public opinion to provoke war between the $$地球連合$$ and the $$コーディネイター$$s. $$ブルーコスモス$$'s former leader $$ムルタ・アズラエル$$ and current leader $$ロード・ジブリール$$ are also members of $$ロゴス$$. For $$ロゴス$$ as a whole, the goal is precisely to continue the war and pursue profit, and the fact that $$ブルーコスモス$$ raises the banner of eradicating $$コーディネイター$$s is largely due to the personal feelings of those two.
Having no forces of its own, during the previous war it moved the $$地球連合$$ forces in an attempt to annihilate the $$コーディネイター$$s. And after the war, in order to exercise its power more directly, it has had the $$ファントムペイン$$ organized.
After $$デュランダル$$ later exposed its existence and deeds, most of its members were arrested or killed by lynch mobs of enraged citizens. $$ジブリール$$, the last one remaining, had the trump card, the $$レクイエム$$, taken away and was then shot down along with the fleeing ship.

67.DSCR:
A political organization known for its extremism.
Its members are all $$ナチュラル$$s, and under the slogan 'for a blue and pure world', it aims at the exclusion of $$コーディネイター$$s. Among $$ナチュラル$$s there are many who, even without joining $$ブルーコスモス$$, find $$コーディネイター$$s suspect, but that too is a result of the group's manipulation of public consciousness.
Being a political organization is only its public face; behind the scenes it also has the aspect of a secret society that acts as the hands and feet of $$ロゴス$$ in order to bring about the eradication of $$コーディネイター$$s. These plans are advanced by members at the center of the $$地球連合$$ and its military.
After leader $$ムルタ・アズラエル$$ died in the second Battle of $$ヤキン・ドゥーエ$$ in C.E. 71, it lay low for a time. But once $$ロード・ジブリール$$ took over as the new leader, it has been moving the $$大西洋連邦$$ and the media to steer public opinion and lead the $$地球連合$$ and the $$プラント$$ into war once more.
However, $$デュランダル$$'s exposure destroyed the organization's upper ranks along with $$ロゴス$$, and its activities were forced into drastic decline.

68.DSCR:
The nickname of $$プラント$$ Supreme Council Chairman $$ギルバート・デュランダル$$.
$$レイ・ザ・バレル$$ is the one who calls him by it.

69.DSCR:
The combat technique research team of the Earth Federation Forces' lunar garrison.
It was set up for the purposes of evaluation testing and shakedown of new-model units.
Its main duties at present are testing toward the formal mass production of the all-domain general-purpose armament system '$$ガナリー・カーバー$$' and the $$バルゴラ$$ that operates it, and building the combat pattern that uses them, called '$$ＧＳコンバット・アクション$$'.
The captain is Captain $$デンゼル・ハマー$$, and the members are First Lieutenant $$トビー・ワトソン$$ and Second Lieutenant $$セツコ・オハラ$$.
